landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 — no baseline moves inside this commit

qualifying_population.rule: C3 types every damage_modifier packet with the damage and attack classes its own wiki text restricts it to, so a leaf may move only where the walk today prices a damage packet whose class the producer's sourced declaration EXCLUDES, delivered by an attacker the owner skip does not already remove.  Per producer: (a) every leaf of such a damage event's subtree, (b) every leaf of an aggregate over (a) — the attacker's and the subject's breakdown rows and survival blocks, and the scenario's roster-wide objective / timeline_coverage / target_allocation blocks and duration, (c) the snapshot's four shape counters.  Enumerated from the committed scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json and its combat.support_events, before this slice's first src/ edit.

excluded_by_construction.fights/**: the pair engine's single-pair path, which no cross-participant packet reaches; golden_snapshot enters through pipeline.run_fight
excluded_by_construction.combat/support_events/**: the published support-event payload is an explicit key list and neither declared class set is on it, so the packets carry the declaration without moving a receipt

unrestricting_producers.Bloodsong — Expose Weakness: all three damage classes — 'increased damage from all sources'
unrestricting_producers.Dream Maker — Blue Dream Bubble: all three damage classes — the restriction is on the attack axis
unrestricting_producers.Imperial Mandate — Command: all three damage classes — 'damage they take from all sources'

qualifying_population.empty_population_argument: Six of these hold no damage_modifier packet at all.  score_event_view_holder holds Imperial Mandate and score_event_scan_holder holds Black Cleaver; both score-mode receipts carry no events and no support_events, so the rule enumerates nothing from them — and Command excludes no damage class while Carve's resistance branch already gates on exactly the physical class it declares.  A leaf moving in any of them is an unexpected occurrence and stops the slice (R-20).
qualifying_population.golden_population_argument: Structurally empty, not assumed empty: golden_snapshot.py enters through pipeline.run_fight — one pair, no roster — so no snapshot row is ever priced by a cross-participant packet, and C3 changes no pair-side pricer.

carried_from_c2.rule: R-17 freezes the baseline for the whole phase, so this slice's compare also shows C2's 46 leaves.  They are the measured C2 diff, re-measured at HEAD before this slice's first src/ edit, and are carried rather than re-declared.

measured.coupled_golden: 51 differing leaves: C2's 46 carried, of which 7 move further, plus 5 new — 12 leaves are this slice's own occurrences.  Every one lies inside the enumerated population; zero occurrences outside it.  All 12 qualify for investigation under R-15 and each is owed an oracle receipt before the phase-boundary re-capture (R-19).
